products.name: LMSYS Arena Models
products.note: Model evaluation platform; crowdsourced benchmarking; research transparency; no production use

profile_text.body:
LMSYS operates lmarena.ai, a community-driven platform for evaluating and ranking large language models. The site describes itself as an AI ranking and leaderboard service where users can chat with, compare, and vote on AI models across text, image, and code categories, with the stated goal of advancing AI research through real-world, crowdsourced evaluation. User conversations are disclosed to relevant AI providers and may be made public to support research, and the platform also uses conversations for automated evaluation by sending prompts to AI providers at a later time to score and compare their models.

The held facts record LMSYS as a nonprofit organization. Its tracked product, listed as LMSYS Arena Models, is characterized as a model evaluation platform built around crowdsourced benchmarking and research transparency, with a note that it is not intended for production use. No litigation, MCP server registrations, SEC filings, or patent records are associated with the organization.
